def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import glob
    import pandas as pd

    paths = sorted(glob.glob('data/environment/input/water-body-testing-*.csv'))
    if not paths:
        raise FileNotFoundError('No files matched data/environment/input/water-body-testing-*.csv')

    dfs = []
    for p in paths:
        df = pd.read_csv(p)
        df['sourceFile'] = p.split('/')[-1]
        dfs.append(df)

    out = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
    return out

def process(waterBodyAllYears) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = waterBodyAllYears.copy()

    # Standardize key fields
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df['Beach Type Description'] = df['Beach Type Description'].astype(str)

    # Violation is yes/no; treat any case-insensitive 'yes' as exceedance
    viol = df['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df['_isExceed'] = viol.eq('yes')

    # Filter to target years and marine beaches
    df = df[(df['Year'] >= 2002) & (df['Year'] <= 2023) & (df['Beach Type Description'].str.strip().str.lower().eq('marine'))]

    # Average exceedance rate across all marine samples in the period
    rate = df['_isExceed'].mean() * 100.0

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'avgHistoricalExceedanceRatePct': rate,
        'marineSamples': int(df.shape[0]),
        'marineExceedances': int(df['_isExceed'].sum())
    }])
